##### Project general facts

Azura Residences by Invest Group Overseas (IGO) is a luxury waterfront development located within the exclusive Dubai Islands, offering a refined residential experience inspired by the calm elegance of island living. The project combines contemporary architectural design with high-end lifestyle amenities, creating a serene urban retreat surrounded by open water views and a sophisticated coastal atmosphere.

Rising as a 14-storey landmark, the development offers a curated selection of residences with panoramic views of the sea and bay. The architecture emphasizes openness, light, and modern luxury, while the overall design ensures a strong connection to the waterfront setting. Residents benefit from a peaceful yet prestigious environment, with direct access to beaches, marinas, and yacht clubs, reinforcing the project’s resort-style identity.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, including porcelain flooring throughout, fully tiled bathrooms, and wooden veneer doors. Smart home systems are integrated across the residences, alongside European-quality aluminum windows with thermal break technology and double glazing. The kitchens are fitted with HPL cabinetry, porcelain countertops, and built-in European appliances, while wardrobes and joinery are finished to a high standard. The apartments are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a unique complex of five islands located north of Dubai city, offering a diverse island life and vacation-inspired lifestyle. Here you will find luxury resort offerings, village centers with a variety of services and activities, luxury health and sports complexes, as well as beautiful beaches for water sports and green areas for outdoor recreation.

Dubai Islands boasts stunning waterfront views, pristine beaches and world-class amenities. Residents of Dubai Islands enjoy a luxurious and exclusive lifestyle with access to upscale shopping malls, fine dining and vibrant entertainment venues.

Dubai Islands is not only a popular place to live, but also a thriving tourism and business hub. With its strategic location, luxurious amenities and breathtaking surroundings, it continues to attract discerning individuals from around the world seeking the ultimate in waterfront living and investment opportunities.
